# MarketWatch

> MarketWatch is a comprehensive financial news and market data platform providing stock market coverage, investment advice, and personal finance guidance.

MarketWatch delivers real-time market data, financial news, and investment insights covering major indices like the Dow, individual stocks including tech leaders like Nvidia and Micron, and personal finance topics for investors of all levels.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market News
- Financial News
- Market Data
- Investment Advice
- Portfolio Management
- Personal Finance
- Retirement Planning
- Dow Jones
- Nvidia
- Micron
- Boeing
- Sherwin-Williams
- Eastern Time Zone

## Core

- [MarketWatch: Stock Market News - Financial News - MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com): MarketWatch homepage: stock market news, financial data, and investment advice.
